accordion_sections.title: Where is Querim Beach located?
accordion_sections.content: Querim Beach, also known as Keri Beach, is in the northernmost part of Goa, near the Maharashtra border. It's approximately 30 km from Panaji, the state capital.

accordion_sections.title: How do I get to Querim Beach?
accordion_sections.content: By Car/Scooter: The beach is accessible via a scenic drive along the NH 66 highway or coastal roads. By Public Transport: You can take a bus or taxi from nearby towns like Arambol or Mapusa. Closest Airport: Goa International Airport (around 60 km away).

accordion_sections.title: What are the highlights of Querim Beach?
accordion_sections.content: Peaceful and less crowded compared to other Goan beaches. Ideal for relaxation, sunbathing, or long walks. Home to the Terekhol River estuary and nearby Terekhol Fort. Picturesque palm trees and casuarina forests.

accordion_sections.title: Is Querim Beach safe for swimming?
accordion_sections.content: Swimming is generally safe, but visitors should exercise caution as there are no lifeguards, and the waters can have strong currents in some areas.

accordion_sections.title: Is Querim Beach family-friendly?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Querim Beach is family-friendly, offering a serene atmosphere away from the busy nightlife typical of other Goan beaches.

accordion_sections.title: Are pets allowed on the Querim beach?
accordion_sections.content: There are no official restrictions, but it's courteous to keep pets leashed and clean up after them.

accordion_sections.title: Are there water sports or activities available on the Querim Beach?
accordion_sections.content: Querim Beach is not a major hub for water sports, but activities like parasailing and jet skiing might be available seasonally. It's better known for its tranquil environment.

accordion_sections.title: When is the best time to visit Querim Beach?
accordion_sections.content: The best time to visit Querim Beach is between November and February when the weather is cool and pleasant.

accordion_sections.title: What makes Querim Beach unique?
accordion_sections.content: Its untouched beauty, less commercialized atmosphere, and proximity to the historic Terekhol Fort make it a unique getaway for nature lovers and peace seekers.
